CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, January 17, 2024 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Laura Longoria, Commission Member
  Danielle Massaro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE NOVEMBER 15, 2023 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  January 17, 2024
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, November 15, 2023
  7:00 P.M.

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:07 P.M. on Wednesday, November 15, 2023, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, and Commission
Member Hermano.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Longoria and Commission Member
Massaro.
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor
Amanda Leonard and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE OCTOBER 18, 2023 REGULAR C.A.C.E.
MEETING
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second from Commission Member Hermano
the October 18, 2023 minutes were approved.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
Commission Member Hermano presented a Burke Heritage Park mural rendering and budget of
children playing baseball and dodgeball in an open field from the California School for the Arts
– San Gabriel Valley (CSARTs). The Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission
recommended revising the children’s clothing to reflect different eras from the past and to
include Mt. Wilson and the San Gabriel Mountains. President Canseco and Vice President
Saunders will return to the next City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting with quotes
after meeting with their artist.

STAFF REPORT
Recreation Supervisor Leonard shared event details from the Alhambra Pumpkin Run and
Veteran’s Day then invited the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission to participate as
judges for the Holiday Home Decorating Contest and ambassadors for the 2024 City of
Alhambra Tournament of Rose Parade float decorating.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
Angela Alvarenga, fine arts painter and children’s book illustrator, introduced herself to the City
Arts and Cultural Events Commission and shared her extensive 20 year work experience of
utility box art, murals, youth workshops and lectures. For the past three years Mrs. Alvarenga
has displayed her art in solo and collaborative exhibitions in the Alhambra City Hall Art Gallery.
 Vice President Saunders agreed to connect Mrs. Alvarenga with Commission Member Longoria
as her proposed Alhambra Art Project includes utility art boxes.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
With a motion from Commission Member Hermano and a second from Vice President Saunders
the December 20, 2023 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting will be cancelled in
observance of the holidays and resume on January 19th 2024.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Commission Member Massaro and second by Vice President Saunders, the
November 15, 2023 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:36
P.M.
